provider: OpenAI Files API — per-project file storage

free_tier.stated: 2.5 TB per project; 512 MB per file; no organization-wide storage cap; orgs may create up to 2,000 projects by default
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Not metered separately for upload/download of files; retrieval is a plain authenticated GET. No published per-GB transfer fee on the Files API surface.

interface_detail: REST `POST/GET/DELETE /v1/files`, `GET /v1/files/{file_id}/content`; OpenAI SDKs; works through OpenAI-compatible gateways
tooling: openai-python, openai-node, curl; `purpose` field selects the lifecycle class
chaining: 2,000 projects/org x 2.5 TB = nominally 5 PB per org. Files are project-scoped and cannot be moved between projects, so a pooler must track (project -> file_id). Because `purpose=batch` and `purpose=vision` are both uploadable AND downloadable, they are the only two classes usable as actual storage.
limits_note: Per-object-cap 512 MB. Upload rate 1,000 requests/min/authenticated user. Vector-store attachment has its own 2,000 files/min/org limit. `purpose` is the real gate. See reliability_note.
reliability_note: READ GATE IS PER-PURPOSE, NOT PER-ACCOUNT. An OpenAI staff-adjacent answer on the developer forum gives the directionality table: assistants up/NO down; user_data up/NO down; fine-tune up/NO down; evals up/NO down; **batch up/YES down**; **vision up/YES down**; *_output down only. So `purpose=user_data` and `purpose=assistants` are write-only. Uploading there is data loss. Storage is genuinely free (no per-GB-day charge for raw files; the $0.10/GB-day on the pricing page is *vector store* storage, not Files API storage). Identity: ChatGPT signup is email-only, but generating the FIRST API key now mandates phone verification (SMS or WhatsApp, one number reusable 3x, rolled out to a listed set of countries). That is the binding constraint here.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
